name: Fraud
description: First- and third-party fraud across cards, payments, and digital channels.

metrics.name: fraud_losses
metrics.description: Gross fraud losses recognized in the period

metrics.name: fraud_loss_rate
metrics.description: Fraud losses divided by payment volume

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraud value detected before loss divided by total fraud value

metrics.name: false_positive_ratio
metrics.description: Legitimate transactions declined per fraudulent transaction caught

conventions.rule: Fraud is confirmed with a lag; recent periods are understated until claims mature.
State whether losses are before or after recoveries and chargebacks.

caveats.text: The most recent weeks are incomplete because fraud reporting lags.

chart_conventions.rule: Show fraud losses in bps of volume alongside absolute losses.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
